chapters.title: Black Swordsman
content: The Black Swordsman introduces Guts, a grim warrior who travels through a dark and unforgiving medieval world.
He carries an enormous sword across his back and possesses a mechanical arm that hides weapons of its own.
Guts travels from one settlement to another, following rumors of supernatural creatures that have taken human lives.
He enters a town where the people live in fear of a powerful ruler who controls everything through violence.
Inside a crowded tavern, Guts encounters a group of criminals mistreating a small elf.
The criminals laugh at the strange warrior and believe that his silence means weakness.
Guts suddenly draws his enormous sword and the atmosphere inside the tavern changes completely.
The fight is short and brutal, leaving the criminals defeated and terrified.
A small elf named Puck becomes fascinated by the mysterious warrior and decides to follow him.
Guts tells Puck to stay away, but the elf refuses to abandon him.
The ruler of the town is eventually revealed to be a monstrous supernatural being.
Guts confronts the creature despite knowing that the battle may cost him his life.
The creature believes that humans are insignificant and that nobody can challenge its power.
Guts refuses to surrender and uses every weapon available to him.
The battle establishes the dangerous world in which Guts lives.
His journey is not simply about survival. He is searching for enemies connected to the darkness of his past.
Puck begins to realize that the cold warrior may not be as heartless as he appears.
The two leave the town behind and continue toward an uncertain future.
The Black Swordsman's journey has only just begun.

chapters.title: The Mark
content: The night grows darker as Guts travels along an abandoned road.
The forest around him is silent, but he knows that something is watching from the shadows.
Puck notices a strange wound on Guts and asks him about it.
Guts refuses to explain and continues walking without slowing down.
A cold wind suddenly passes through the trees.
The warrior stops and looks toward the darkness.
Several strange creatures begin moving between the trees.
Puck becomes frightened, but Guts immediately reaches for his sword.
The creatures attack from every direction.
Guts fights through them one after another, refusing to retreat.
The battle continues until the forest becomes completely silent again.
Puck discovers that the strange mark on Guts has begun bleeding.
Guts explains that the mark attracts supernatural creatures.
Puck realizes that following Guts means entering a world far more dangerous than he imagined.
Despite his fear, Puck decides to remain beside him.
Guts watches the sunrise without saying anything.
The road ahead is long, and the creatures following him are becoming stronger.
He knows that another battle will come soon.

chapters.title: The Ruined Village
content: Guts and Puck arrive at a village surrounded by burned fields.
The houses are damaged and the streets are almost completely empty.
An old man approaches them and warns them not to stay after sunset.
According to the villagers, strange sounds can be heard coming from the forest every night.
Guts ignores the warning and enters one of the abandoned buildings.
Inside, he discovers signs that the villagers left in a hurry.
Puck searches the nearby rooms while Guts examines the ground.
He discovers unusual footprints leading toward the forest.
As darkness falls, the village becomes strangely quiet.
A distant scream breaks the silence.
Guts immediately grabs his sword and leaves the building.
Several creatures emerge from the forest.
The villagers hide inside their homes while Guts stands alone in the street.
The creatures attack together.
Guts fights with overwhelming determination.
Puck helps several villagers escape while Guts holds the creatures back.
By morning, the village is damaged but still standing.
The villagers thank Guts, but he refuses their reward.
He simply walks toward the next road.

chapters.title: The Hunter
content: A mysterious hunter begins following Guts from a distance.
Unlike the supernatural creatures, the hunter is human.
He carries a longbow and appears to know a great deal about Guts.
Puck notices him several times but Guts refuses to react.
Eventually, the hunter steps into the road and introduces himself.
He claims to have information about the creatures Guts is searching for.
Guts immediately suspects that the hunter is hiding something.
The hunter explains that a powerful creature has recently appeared in the northern mountains.
Guts decides to investigate.
The journey toward the mountains takes several days.
During the journey, the hunter tells stories about villages destroyed by monsters.
Puck becomes increasingly worried about what they will find.
Guts remains focused on the destination.
When they reach the mountains, they discover an abandoned fortress.
The fortress appears empty from the outside.
However, strange sounds echo from inside its walls.
Guts draws his sword and enters without hesitation.

chapters.title: The Fortress
content: The interior of the fortress is covered with dust and broken weapons.
Old banners hang from the walls, barely visible in the darkness.
The hunter discovers a hidden passage beneath the main hall.
Guts enters the passage while Puck stays close behind him.
The tunnel leads deep beneath the fortress.
They eventually discover a massive underground chamber.
The walls are covered with strange symbols.
The hunter recognizes them as signs connected to an ancient ritual.
Before anyone can react, the entrance closes behind them.
A deep voice echoes through the chamber.
Something enormous begins moving in the darkness.
Guts prepares himself for another battle.
The creature emerges from the shadows and towers over the group.
The hunter fires several arrows, but they have almost no effect.
Guts attacks directly.
The creature responds with incredible strength.
The chamber shakes as the battle continues.
Puck searches for another way out while Guts keeps the creature occupied.

chapters.title: Blood Moon
content: A red moon rises above the fortress.
The strange light enters the underground chamber through cracks in the ceiling.
The creature becomes stronger beneath the moonlight.
Guts realizes that the battle cannot continue forever.
His injuries are becoming more serious with every attack.
Puck discovers an ancient mechanism hidden behind the wall.
The mechanism appears to control the fortress gates.
Puck desperately attempts to activate it.
The hunter protects him from the creature's attacks.
Guts launches one final attack.
The creature blocks the sword and throws Guts across the chamber.
For a moment, everything becomes silent.
Guts slowly rises from the ground.
He grips his sword again.
The battle resumes with even greater intensity.
Puck finally activates the mechanism.
The fortress begins collapsing around them.
The group escapes moments before the underground chamber is destroyed.

chapters.title: The Journey
content: Guts, Puck, and the hunter continue their journey after escaping the fortress.
The hunter admits that he originally intended to use Guts as bait.
Guts is angry but decides that there is no reason to waste time fighting him.
Puck is surprised that Guts chooses to let the hunter live.
The three travelers eventually reach a small mountain settlement.
The villagers are preparing for an approaching storm.
Guts decides to stay for one night.
Puck explores the village while Guts repairs his equipment.
The hunter studies a map and identifies several locations connected to supernatural activity.
One location appears far more dangerous than the others.
Guts decides that it will be their next destination.
That night, thunder shakes the village.
A mysterious figure appears outside the village walls.
Guts notices the figure immediately.
He picks up his sword and walks outside.

chapters.title: The Eclipse
content: The sky above the village changes color.
The stars disappear behind a strange darkness.
Puck feels an overwhelming sense of fear.
Guts realizes that something ancient has awakened.
The villagers run into their homes.
The mysterious figure standing outside begins transforming.
Guts prepares himself for the confrontation.
The ground begins shaking beneath their feet.
Strange lights appear in the sky.
The hunter realizes that the event may be connected to an ancient legend.
Guts refuses to listen and focuses entirely on the enemy.
The creature attacks with incredible speed.
Guts barely avoids the first strike.
The battle moves through the ruined streets.
Puck searches for injured villagers while Guts fights alone.
The night becomes a desperate struggle for survival.
Guts realizes that defeating the creature may require more than strength.

chapters.title: The Last Stand
content: The village is almost completely destroyed.
Guts stands among the ruins with his sword covered in dust.
The creature approaches once again.
There is almost no strength left in Guts's body.
Puck begs him to stop fighting.
Guts refuses to surrender.
He remembers every enemy that has stood in his way.
He remembers the people he failed to protect.
Those memories give him enough strength to continue.
The creature launches its final attack.
Guts moves forward instead of retreating.
The two collide in a final exchange.
For a moment, the battlefield becomes completely silent.
The creature falls.
Guts remains standing, barely able to move.
Puck runs toward him.
The surviving villagers slowly emerge from their shelters.
Guts looks toward the horizon.
There are still more enemies waiting somewhere beyond the mountains.

chapters.title: Beyond the Horizon
content: Several days later, the travelers leave the ruined village.
The road ahead is covered with fog.
Puck walks beside Guts while the hunter follows several steps behind.
Nobody speaks for a long time.
The events of the previous night have changed the way they see the world.
The hunter admits that he no longer wants to continue hunting supernatural creatures.
Guts simply tells him to choose his own path.
At a crossroads, the hunter decides to leave the group.
Puck asks Guts where they are going next.
Guts points toward the distant mountains.
He has heard rumors about another powerful enemy hiding there.
Puck sighs but follows him anyway.
The sun slowly rises over the horizon.
The darkness of the previous night begins to disappear.
Guts continues walking without looking back.
His journey is far from over.
There are still monsters to face, mysteries to uncover, and memories that refuse to disappear.
The two travelers disappear into the distance as the road stretches endlessly before them.
